--- set_operator_left_outer_intersect_distinct.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
RETURN 1 AS id
LEFT OUTER INTERSECT DISTINCT
RETURN 2 AS id
LEFT OUTER INTERSECT DISTINCT
RETURN 3 AS id
